chunk_text: Review permissions granted to enterprise applications. The review uses the enterprise application permissions view to inspect delegated permissions, application permissions, consent status, and permission scope for an application.
Remove a password from an application. The request body requires keyId, the unique identifier for the password. A successful request returns 204 No Content.

Add an owner to an application. Application owners can be individual users, the associated service principal, or another service principal. The request body supplies the directory object identifier to assign as owner.

source_title: Reviewing and revoking authorization of GitHub Apps
chunk_text: Review authorized GitHub Apps and revoke authorization when access is no longer needed. The page describes reviewing and revoking authorization of GitHub Apps.

source_title: Setting a personal access token policy for your organization
chunk_text: Organization owners can control access to resources by applying policies to personal access tokens. Policy options include restricting access, enforcing maximum lifetime, and requiring approval for fine-grained personal access tokens.

source_title: Control which third-party & internal apps access Google Workspace data
chunk_text: Control which third-party and internal apps access Google Workspace data. Administrators can review app access and manage whether apps are trusted, limited, or blocked.
